case.question: How many business days does standard delivery usually need?

result.message: How many business days does standard delivery usually need?
result.response: Standard delivery generally takes 3–7 business days after dispatch. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays. Delivery estimates are not guarantees; carrier or weather delays may occur. Contact customer support if delivery exceeds the estimated window.
